metadata.description: MagLab harness manifest — declarative routing table (§5.16)

agents.name: citation-auditor
agents.description: Validates DOI, metadata, duplicates, OA status, and retraction. Receives a candidate list from search-scout, validates each paper, and updates the evidence_matrix (§14.7).

agents.name: local-context-librarian
agents.description: Pre-checks local notes and existing references for evidence and duplicates. Step 1 of research orchestration — queries the local corpus before a broad search to identify what is already held and what gaps remain (§14.7).

agents.name: paper-reviewer
agents.description: Reads 3–7 key papers in depth and extracts claims, evidence, and methodology. Targets T1·T2 papers verified by citation-auditor (§14.7).

agents.name: physics-validator
agents.description: Delegate when validating the physical plausibility of physics quantities, simulations, and fitting results via the sanity oracle. Checks dimensions, ranges, and conservation laws.

agents.name: result-analyst
agents.description: Delegate when a batch of measurement/simulation results needs to be digested in an isolated context and only compressed analysis conclusions should be returned.

agents.name: search-scout
agents.description: Broadly collects candidate papers using MCP connectors and skills. Generates 3–6 query families and assigns tier classifications (§14.7).

agents.name: synthesis-editor
agents.description: Writes a topic-centred (not paper-by-paper) synthesis report. Receives paper-reviewer results and produces synthesis text with DOI evidence (§14.7).

agents.name: comms-writer
agents.description: Delegate when drafting research communications, summaries, or reports for a non-specialist audience. Transforms technical findings into clear, structured prose.

agents.name: experiment-manager
agents.description: Owns the research tree (§5.12) — chooses the best pending node to expand, prunes branches by failure type, and records outcomes. Keeps tree-search state separate from the orchestrator.

agents.name: hypothesis-gen
agents.description: Generates ranked, physics-grounded, falsifiable research hypotheses for a topic via an Elo tournament with physics reflection (D1, §5.10). Backs the maglab hypotheses command.

skills.name: literature-review
skills.description: Deep structured extraction of claims, evidence, and methodology from verified papers.

skills.name: literature-search
skills.description: Multi-connector literature search with query expansion and tier classification.

skills.name: physics-oracle
skills.description: Deterministic physics sanity checks — dimension analysis, range validation, unit conversion.

workflows.name: survey
workflows.description: Full literature survey — local pre-check, broad search, citation audit, deep review, synthesis (§14.7).

workflows.name: paper-review
workflows.description: Deep review of a specific paper set — citation audit then in-depth reading and extraction (§14.7).

workflows.name: citation-map
workflows.description: DOI/metadata validation and citation graph audit for a candidate paper list (§14.7).

workflows.name: local-gap
workflows.description: Pre-check local notes and existing references to identify coverage gaps before a broad search (§14.7).
